fields.name: Requests
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x1D16050 allocates 16 bytes and registers the generic array destructor thunk bg3.exe+0x5946C0 (the same one SE's notes give for ecl::timeline::RenderFrameVisibilityRequestsComponent). ecl::screen_fade::ScreenFadeSystem::ProcessClearScreenFadeRequests (EoCClient.dll+0x7E9D50), whose WorldView lists this component, iterates each clear-request component as a DynamicArray of 0x20-byte elements copying a Guid (+0), 8 bytes (+0x10, two floats) and one byte (+0x18) - the layout of SE's ClearScreenFadeData (Guid FadeId, float FadeSpeed, float FadeTime, uint8 field_18). macOS default ctor: 16 zero bytes. Live (idle): all zero.

open_questions: The four clear-request loops in ProcessClearScreenFadeRequests were not individually matched to type indices; all have the same 0x20 element shape.
status_reason: only empty (all-zero) instances were seen: the member boundaries are untested
hold: uses types declared elsewhere (ClearScreenFadeData): Script Extender's own headers or another layout; whether they are declared before this one is not checked yet
